title: Exact adjoint forgetting: injectives and derived detection
statement: Let $\mathcal B,\mathcal A$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] in compatible chosen universes, and let $A:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $U:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be additive exact functors with $A\dashv U$. Assume $U$ is conservative. Then $U$ preserves injective objects and K-injective complexes, where K-injective means that every map from an acyclic complex is null-homotopic [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. On ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], termwise $U$ induces a conservative triangulated functor $D(U):D(\mathcal B)\to D(\mathcal A)$. For every $r\in\mathbf Z$ it has the natural cohomology comparison $H^rD(U)\cong UH^r$, compatible with the kernel-modulo-image formula on representative complexes, chain maps, homotopies and localization at quasi-isomorphisms. In particular, if $D(U)(f)$ is invertible, every $U(H^r(f))$ and then every $H^r(f)$ is invertible, and $f$ is invertible. For any object $M$ and integer $r$, the canonical single-degree comparison is $D(U)(M[r])\cong U(M)[r]$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives] to the exact left adjoint $A$ and its right adjoint $U$. Thus $U$ preserves injective objects. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] with its $u=U$, $v=A$, and its source category equal to $\mathcal B$. Its two hypotheses are exactly the given additive adjunction and exactness of $A$, so $U$ also preserves K-injective complexes.

Apply [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] with $F=U$. Exactness and additivity of $U$ give the termwise induced triangulated functor $D(U):D(\mathcal B)\to D(\mathcal A)$, commuting with shifts. This construction needs neither injective resolutions nor boundedness. The same cited statement gives the canonical comparison $D(U)(M[r])\cong U(M)[r]$ for every object $M$ of $\mathcal B$ and integer $r$.

proof.text: Use the existing proved natural isomorphism U.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso r, and take its inverse as chi. Its hom_app_Q theorem is exactly the required representative formula. Naturality for all derived morphisms is part of this natural isomorphism, so no compositor coherence theorem is needed. Termwise homotopy preservation is the proved additive-functor construction U.mapHomotopy. All of these constructions apply to arbitrary unbounded complexes.

source.place: mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso_hom_app_Q; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/Homotopy.lean: Functor.mapHomotopy; Stacks derived.tex Tag 015F

proof.text: For every derived morphism f with D(U)(f) invertible, apply NatIso.isIso_map_iff to U.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso r. Since H^r sends D(U)(f) to an isomorphism, U(H^r(f)) is an isomorphism. Reflect it through U to obtain invertibility of every H^r(f), and apply [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology] (DerivedCategory.isIso_iff B f). Package this same detection argument as D(U).ReflectsIsomorphisms and as the explicit chain of implications. Assemble these results with steps 1-3 and mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor.
